title: Renaming the unused default term keeps it the default
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, the shop's default for new customers and held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-29 Fourteen.
  • A new name for it, {Term-B}, that no term has.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-29 Two Weeks.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace the Name with {Term-B}.
  4. Click "Save Changes".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens and "Edit" is available.
  • Step 2: the "Edit Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 3: the Name reads {Term-B}.
  • Step 4: the window closes, the toast "{Term-B} saved" shows, and the row now reads {Term-B} with the "Default" tag still on it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-E1: “Editing the name of an unused term that is the current default keeps it the default under its new name.”
  • S2-R4: “"Edit" opens the "Edit Credit Term" window (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) filled with the term's name, kind and days.”
